items.title: Panama by Air (Reel 4)
items.creator: R. A. Duhem, Duhem and Harter Motion Picture Company
items.basis: Internet Archive public domain mark; released 1914
items.date_basis: flights of 25 and 27 April 1913, Canal Record VI no. 36, pp. 297-298 (F63); released 1914: read every intertitle for post-August wording before use
items.seen: Aerial views of the canal from a hydro-biplane, the Culebra Cut among them; the IA blurb's landing in Gatun Lake conflicts with the Record's Cristobal landing.

items.title: President Roosevelt's arrival at Panama, 15 November 1906
items.creator: unknown, as the record states
items.archive: Library of Congress, Motion Picture, Broadcasting and Recorded Sound Division
items.basis: Library of Congress: not aware of any U.S. copyright or other restrictions; free to use and reuse
items.seen: The procession in Panama City on 15 November 1906; Amador's address on the cathedral steps; Roosevelt speaks. Overlaps mp76000225.

items.title: President Taft's inspection of the Panama Canal (Signal Corps 111-M-331)
items.creator: United States Army Signal Corps
items.basis: a Signal Corps production, a United States government work (founder default of 8 Nov 2026; NARA 'Use Restriction: Undetermined', still to be checked)
items.date_basis: the catalogue's 1910 is impossible (the Arkansas was commissioned in September 1912); the Canal Record dates the voyage to 19 to 26 December 1912 (F64); content may be mixed, view before use
items.seen: Taft addresses a crowd and embarks on the Arkansas at Key West; excavation, dredging, the Pedro Miguel and Miraflores locks, Gatun Lake, the spillway, 'native dwellings'.
